reviews.text: My wife and I couldn't be happier with the superior service, pricing and the completed project which Elizabeth, Mel and the team at Lane Home Improvement provided to us! From start to finish, their excellent customer service, attention to detail and quality of work was exceptional. We appreciated all of the time and effort they spent explaining the very involved project scope (shingle selection, roof tear-off, sheathing replacement, underlayment, ridge vents, gutters, leaf guards and downspouts). They continuously offered advice, listened to our concerns throughout the project and worked…
reviews.author: Harry Meise

reviews.text: I've had a few issues going on with my roof and ventilation in my attic and so far I've only completed the roof repair portion of the services they have recommended, but the team at Lane Home Improvement has been incredibly knowledgeable and professional about taking care of my problems. Looking forward to getting the rest of the work done as needed and definitely recommend this roofing company to anyone else looking to take care of their home.
reviews.author: Hannah Johnson

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Lane Home Improvement. They did a fantastic job on our church’s roof. Their crew was respectful and worked fast. The owners were clear and fair in their pricing. They went above and beyond, ensuring our parking lot was clean for services and they even power washed our sidewalks! Truly, this is one of the best companies I’ve ever worked with.
reviews.author: Ben Hyrne
